name: tokenbreak
description: Opt-in ads for Claude Code: a banner above the prompt and a Theater pane while Claude works. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.

endpoint.title: Ad server
endpoint.description: Where Tokenbreak fetches ads and reports impressions. Set http://localhost:3000 while running the site locally. Unreachable means built-in house ads only.

frequency.title: Banner rotation
frequency.description: chill rotates the banner every 90s, normal every 40s, max every 20s.

theater.title: Theater pane
theater.description: on opens a pane beside the transcript during turns longer than a few seconds (fullscreen layout, 144+ columns). off never opens it.

pictures.title: Pictures
pictures.description: on draws banner logos, Theater images and video ads. off keeps ads text only.

sound.title: Theater sound
sound.description: on plays a video ad's sound when the Theater opens (macOS); the mute button silences it and stays muted until you unmute. off keeps ads silent unless you press the sound button.
